units: <cite ref="Pesachim 36b:16">Pes. 36ᵇ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Beitzah 22b:3">Bets. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אופין פת ע׳ וכ׳</he> you must not bake thick bread on the Passover; <he>וכמה פת ע׳ טפח</he> and how high must it be to be called thick bread? One handbreadth; <cite ref="Beitzah 22b:3">ib.</cite> (Rabbi’s interpret.) <he>פת מרובה</he> a large batch; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עָבִים</he>, <cite ref="P00048"><he>עָבִין</he></cite>; <cite ref="P00035"><he>עָבוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 11</cite> <he>אלו הן הע׳</he> these are the thick (heavy) garments; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:8">Kel. XXVIII, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:3:2">Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הע׳ הרכים</he> the thick but soft garments.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:3">Mikv. VIII, 3</cite> <he>טפין ע׳</he> thick (turbid) drops; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 5:1:6">Y. Kil. V, beg. 29ᵈ</cite> <he>היו עבות</he>, ed. Krot. <he>העבות</he>, R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:1">Kil. V, 1</cite> <he>היו עבים</he>, read: <he>הֶעֱבוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="P00007"><he>עָבָה</he></cite>.]
